Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the date format in the Britannica source, conflating "June 10, 1819" (10/06/1819) with "October 6, 1819" (06/10/1819), due to potential ISO or US vs. international date format confusion. Despite all sources consistently reporting the birth date as June 10, 1819 (or 10 June 1819, depending on format), the Planner introduced an erroneous reformulation in Step 9, stating the date as "October 6, 1819." This error was likely a result of incorrect standardization or formatting assumptions, leading to an inaccurate final date being synthesized. This pattern matches an error type seen in the reference examples, where date format confusion stemming from regional differences results in incorrect synthesis, even when sources align.
